enabled.label: Auto-loot on
enabled.description: Pick up currency near you by itself. /currencyaura on|off switches it in game.

radius.label: Pickup radius
radius.description: How close an item must be to be picked up. Gold's own auto-loot reaches 15 cells.

skip.label: Never pick up
skip.description: Exact item names (or metadata ids) left on the ground, e.g. Scroll Fragment.
